status_meaning.satisfied: The named original contract has direct passing evidence in the stated fixtures; not a universal theorem or N9 sign-off.
status_meaning.partial: Some named original assertions pass; only the linked remaining actions are mandatory for closure.
status_meaning.missing: No automated production evidence establishes this specific original required case.
status_meaning.decision: An explicit acceptance-policy/scope choice remains, not a new implementation authorization.

remaining_actions.title: Approve the production IMEX timestep comparison contract
remaining_actions.change_scope: No automatic change to CFL or addition of adaptive retry.
exit_conditions: Use the existing directional-bound agreement, combined-timestep difference and actual-tableau order/stage evidence.
Confirm the accepted retained IMEX policy or explicitly authorize a separate targeted correction if the remaining finite-time tests expose a failure.

acceptance_rules: Preserve existing numerical tolerances, mandatory original-duration restart tests and raw conservative-state checks.
For new fixtures define seeds, comparison times, independent oracles and acceptance limits before executing the test; do not tune limits after failures.
New numerical fixtures use strict/optimized builds and real 1/4-thread comparisons; passing newly added cases updates the relevant original requirement only.
Reuse current evidence when source/test hashes match; do not rerun the full solver suite for this metadata/documentation-only reconciliation.
No N7/N8 milestone closes while its mapped mandatory actions or decisions remain unresolved; N9 remains a separate approval.
outside_this_closure: A universal positivity proof or a new adaptive whole-step retry mechanism.
Exhaustive characterization of every rheology, pore-pressure inhibition model, entrainment or vaporization law beyond the availability/transport contracts above.
Nonautonomous inlet/fissure source timing and end-to-end injection budgets, source overlap geometry, NetCDF metadata and long-run provenance: retain in N9/model characterization.
M12c build/CI modernization, A1/A2 source organization, layers, local domains, MPI and GPU work.
New nonuniform production mesh support or a replacement spatial/time integration method.
